obligations.index_set_coverage: Every positive N, including bounded N, is inside the published domain.

obligations.uniformity: C fixed independently of N; P may vary.
obligations.normalizations: Strict upper endpoint follows from compositeness of2CN.
obligations.exceptional_cases: N=1 valid; no exceptional modulus or prime exclusion.
obligations.quantitative_strength: Exact fixed factor2 interval; no prime-number asymptotic imported.
obligations.downstream_consumption: Consumer uses only the prime and bounded ratio to zero-extend onto Z/PZ; its later norm calculations are unchanged.
